Title: Small World Zinc search
Description: Retrieves molecules structurally close to a query compound from ZINC, using SmallWorld, an index covering more than 230 billion molecular substructures. Instead of computing similarity locally, the query is posted to the public SmallWorld server and the 100 closest neighbours within a graph-edit distance of 10 are returned, restricted to the ZINC map rather than the full index. Output therefore depends on an external service and reflects the state of that index when the query is run.
Interpretation: List of the 100 nearest neighbours to the query molecule in the ZINC library.
